title: 1080p Inspection Camera / Endoscope – IP67 for Car, Pipes & Engine
descriptionHtml:
Can't reach the fault you're looking for?

Behind the engine block, inside the drain pipe, in the ventilation or behind the wall – the hardest faults are always where the eye can't reach. Guessing, taking things apart and hoping only leads to more work.

See into the hidden – in sharp 1080p

The waterproof (IP67) endoscope camera gets into tight, dark spaces and shows everything in razor-sharp 1080p with built-in LED lighting. Find the fault right away – in the car, the pipe or the engine – without taking anything apart.

Features

  • 1080p HD – sharp picture down to the smallest detail.
  • IP67 waterproof – withstands pipes, liquid and dirt.
  • Built-in LED – sees even in pitch darkness.
  • Flexible cable – reaches into tight spaces.
  • Rechargeable lithium battery.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
